name: Pythilo
subtitle: Python IDE, course and labs
promotionalText: Python 3.14 on iPhone and iPad. Learn through 430 lessons and 120 Labs. Download courses and packages when needed; train real BERT and LoRA projects on device.
description:
Real Python, on your iPhone and iPad.

Pythilo combines a Python IDE, courses and interactive Labs. CPython 3.14 runs on your device. Download the packages and learning material you need, then code and train offline.

A complete workspace
• Multi-file projects, folders, a touch editor, completion and diagnostics.
• input(), clear tracebacks, Stop, breakpoints, stepping and variables.
• A terminal with pipes, redirects, pytest, pip, Git, sqlite3 and npm.
• Git commits, branches, diffs, merge, rebase and HTTPS clone.
• Ordinary .ipynb notebooks and a SQLite browser.

Download what you use
• Courses and Lab topics download separately.
• New projects save their source immediately and automatically queue required packages and assets.
• See sizes and progress; pause, resume, cancel or remove downloads.
• Removing downloads preserves project code, lesson drafts and progress.
• Compiled Python backends remain in the signed app; their Python APIs download separately.

Web and machine learning
• Django, Flask, FastAPI, Pydantic, Starlette and Uvicorn on the device.
• Start a local server and open its preview. Build React with esbuild.
• NumPy, PyTorch, SymPy and NetworkX, plus per-project pure-Python pip packages.
• Real PyTorch CPU training and Core ML inference from Python.
• Six complete pretrained BERT projects: full fine-tuning, query/value LoRA, domain transfer, budget comparisons, exact checkpoint recovery and merged-model export.
• The UCI review dataset, tokenizer and pretrained weights download once and are shared between projects. Training and evaluation run locally.

Learn by writing code
• 430 lessons in 35 courses, plus 100 timed interview tasks.
• Python foundations, architecture, async, testing, Pydantic, HTTP APIs, mathematics, ML, transformers and AI systems.
• Runnable examples, hints, worked answers and checks that explain failures.
• 122 advanced lessons with 30 integration projects.

See your algorithms work
• 120 Labs in 15 expandable topics: 57 ML and 40 AI Labs.
• Search by concept, trace your own code and replay each step.
• 88 linked lesson/Lab pairs. 74 Labs also run in the free browser playground.

Work together
• Encrypted rooms with live edits and cursors. Remote execution needs device-owner permission.
• Connect an AI client over your local network or through a room.
• No account, analytics or advertising. Your projects stay yours.

Made for iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape, keyboard and touch.

Limits: no Node.js, Jupyter server, pandas, Matplotlib or SciPy. PyTorch uses CPU; no MPS or torch.compile. iOS pauses servers in the background.

reviewNotes: This draft is prepared for a future release; no submission is requested. Pythilo embeds CPython 3.14 and runs the user's own code locally as an educational and development tool. No account or login is required. To try: Projects > New project > CSV Cleaner, open main.py and tap Run; use the Terminal to run pytest. Learn offers runnable lessons and Labs traces the user's algorithms. pip installs pure-Python packages from PyPI only when the user requests it; compiled backends are bundled and signed; their Python APIs download separately. Courses and Lab topics download from pythilo.com, and creating a project automatically queues its required packages and optional public dataset/model assets. Downloads have progress, pause/resume, verification and removal, while project code remains local. npm fetches packages and esbuild builds them without Node.js. The built-in preview opens local web servers. The Local Network permission supports local servers and MCP connections initiated by the user. Shared rooms use https://pythilo.com, carry end-to-end encrypted project data, and require device-owner permission for remote run requests. There are no analytics or advertising SDKs.
